keep.en: Please keep your notes organized so they are easy to review.
keep.zh: 請把筆記整理好，方便之後複習。

key.en: Understanding the key idea makes the passage much easier to follow.
key.zh: 理解關鍵概念後，文章會容易讀懂許多。

kick.en: He gave the ball a strong kick toward the goal.

kid.en: Every kid in the group received a small notebook.
kid.zh: 小組裡每個孩子都拿到一本小筆記本。

kill.en: Extreme heat can kill young plants if they lack water.
kill.zh: 如果缺水，極端高溫可能使幼苗枯死。

kind.en: A kind comment can encourage someone who feels uncertain.
kind.zh: 一句友善的話能鼓勵感到沒自信的人。

king.en: The history book describes how the king ruled the country.
king.zh: 歷史課本描述這位國王如何統治國家。

kitchen.en: The kitchen was cleaned before the cooking activity began.
kitchen.zh: 烹飪活動開始前，廚房已經清理乾淨。

knee.en: She hurt her knee while running down the stairs.
knee.zh: 她跑下樓梯時傷到了膝蓋。

knife.en: Use the knife carefully when cutting the fruit.
knife.zh: 切水果時請小心使用刀具。

knock.en: Please knock before entering the teacher's office.
knock.zh: 進入老師辦公室前請先敲門。

know.en: It is useful to know which study methods work best for you.
know.zh: 了解哪些讀書方法最適合自己很有幫助。

knowledge.en: Background knowledge can make a difficult article easier to understand.
knowledge.zh: 背景知識能讓困難文章更容易理解。

label.en: Please label each sample clearly before starting the experiment.
label.zh: 開始實驗前請清楚標示每個樣本。

labor.en: The report examines how technology has changed physical labor.
labor.zh: 這份報告探討科技如何改變體力勞動。

laboratory.en: Students must wear safety glasses inside the laboratory.
laboratory.zh: 學生在實驗室內必須戴護目鏡。

lack.en: A lack of sleep can reduce concentration during class.
lack.zh: 睡眠不足會降低上課時的專注力。

lady.en: The lady at the information desk showed us the correct direction.
lady.zh: 服務台的女士告訴我們正確方向。

lake.en: We walked around the lake before returning to the bus.
lake.zh: 我們繞湖走了一圈後才回到遊覽車。

land.en: The plane will land shortly after sunset.
land.zh: 飛機會在日落後不久降落。

language.en: Learning a language requires regular practice and meaningful use.
language.zh: 學習語言需要規律練習和實際運用。

large.en: A large number of students joined the environmental campaign.
large.zh: 很多學生參加了這項環保活動。

last.en: The final presentation will last about twenty minutes.
last.zh: 最後的報告大約會持續二十分鐘。

late.en: We arrived late because the train was delayed.
late.zh: 因為火車延誤，我們遲到了。

later.en: We can discuss the difficult question later after class.
later.zh: 我們可以下課後再討論這個難題。

latest.en: Please check the latest schedule before leaving home.
latest.zh: 出門前請確認最新時刻表。

laugh.en: The whole class began to laugh at the funny example.
laugh.zh: 全班聽到那個有趣的例子後笑了起來。

law.en: The new law aims to improve safety on public roads.
law.zh: 這項新法律旨在提升公共道路安全。

lawyer.en: The lawyer explained the case in simple language.
lawyer.zh: 律師用簡單的語言說明這起案件。

lay.en: Please lay the papers flat on the table.

lead.en: Good planning can lead to better results and less stress.
lead.zh: 良好規劃能帶來更好的結果和更少壓力。

leader.en: A good leader listens carefully to different opinions.
leader.zh: 好的領導者會仔細聆聽不同意見。

leadership.en: The program helps students develop teamwork and leadership skills.
leadership.zh: 這項計畫幫助學生培養團隊合作與領導能力。

leaf.en: A green leaf floated slowly down from the tree.
leaf.zh: 一片綠葉從樹上慢慢飄落。

learn.en: Students learn faster when they use new words in context.
learn.zh: 學生在語境中使用新單字時學得更快。

learning.en: Online learning can be effective when students stay organized.
learning.zh: 如果學生有良好規劃，線上學習可以很有效。

least.en: Please read at least two sources before writing the report.
least.zh: 寫報告前請至少閱讀兩個資料來源。

leave.en: Please leave enough time to check your answers.
leave.zh: 請預留足夠時間檢查答案。

lecture.en: The lecture introduced several ideas about renewable energy.
lecture.zh: 這場講座介紹了幾個再生能源相關概念。

left.en: Turn left at the next corner to reach the station.
left.zh: 在下一個路口左轉就能到車站。

leg.en: He injured his leg during basketball practice.
leg.zh: 他在籃球練習時傷到了腿。

legal.en: The article explains the legal rules for using copyrighted material.
legal.zh: 這篇文章說明使用受著作權保護內容的法律規範。

lend.en: Could you lend me your notes after class?
lend.zh: 下課後可以借我你的筆記嗎？

length.en: The teacher asked us to measure the length of the table.
length.zh: 老師要我們測量桌子的長度。

less.en: This method uses less time while producing similar results.
less.zh: 這個方法花更少時間，卻能得到相似結果。

lesson.en: Today's lesson focuses on how to identify the main idea.
lesson.zh: 今天的課程著重於如何找出主旨。

let.en: Please let me know if the schedule changes.
let.zh: 如果行程有變，請告訴我。

letter.en: She wrote a short letter to thank her teacher.
letter.zh: 她寫了一封短信感謝老師。

level.en: This book is suitable for students at an intermediate level.
level.zh: 這本書適合中等程度的學生。

library.en: The library stays open later during exam week.
library.zh: 考試週期間圖書館會開放得比較晚。

lie.en: The village lies between two low mountains.
lie.zh: 這個村莊位於兩座低山之間。

life.en: Regular exercise can improve both health and quality of life.
life.zh: 規律運動能改善健康和生活品質。

lift.en: Please lift the box carefully because it is heavier than it looks.
lift.zh: 請小心抬這個箱子，因為它比看起來重。

light.en: Plants need enough light to grow properly.
light.zh: 植物需要足夠光線才能正常生長。

like.en: Many students like to review vocabulary before going to bed.
like.zh: 許多學生喜歡在睡前複習單字。

likely.en: Regular practice makes success more likely over time.
likely.zh: 規律練習會讓成功的機會隨時間提高。

limit.en: The school placed a limit on the number of books each student can borrow.
limit.zh: 學校限制每位學生可借閱的書本數量。

line.en: Please draw a straight line between the two points.
line.zh: 請在兩點之間畫一條直線。

link.en: The article includes a link to additional information.
link.zh: 這篇文章附有更多資訊的連結。

list.en: Make a list of the main ideas before writing your summary.
list.zh: 寫摘要前先列出主要觀念。

listen.en: Students should listen carefully before answering the question.
listen.zh: 學生在回答問題前應仔細聆聽。

literature.en: The course introduces students to modern Asian literature.
literature.zh: 這門課介紹學生認識現代亞洲文學。

little.en: A little preparation can make a difficult task much easier.
little.zh: 一點準備就能讓困難任務容易許多。

live.en: Many people live near the river because transportation is convenient.
live.zh: 許多人住在河邊，因為交通方便。

local.en: The school bought vegetables from a local farm.
local.zh: 學校向當地農場購買蔬菜。

locate.en: Can you locate the station on this map?
locate.zh: 你能在這張地圖上找到車站的位置嗎？

location.en: The app can show your current location on the map.
location.zh: 這個應用程式可以在地圖上顯示你目前的位置。

lock.en: Remember to lock the classroom door before leaving.
lock.zh: 離開前記得把教室門鎖上。

long.en: The meeting lasted longer than we had expected.
long.zh: 會議持續得比我們預期更久。

look.en: Look at the graph carefully before choosing your answer.
look.zh: 選答案前請仔細看這張圖表。

lose.en: You may lose important files if you forget to save them.
lose.zh: 如果忘記儲存，你可能會遺失重要檔案。

loss.en: The company reported a small loss during the first quarter.
loss.zh: 公司第一季出現小幅虧損。

lot.en: A lot of students attended the science fair this year.
lot.zh: 今年有很多學生參加科展。

loud.en: The music was too loud for us to concentrate.
loud.zh: 音樂太大聲，讓我們無法專心。

love.en: She developed a love of reading at an early age.
love.zh: 她從小就培養出對閱讀的喜愛。

low.en: The temperature remained low throughout the morning.
low.zh: 整個早上氣溫都維持在低點。

luck.en: Good preparation matters more than luck in most exams.
luck.zh: 在多數考試中，充分準備比運氣更重要。

lucky.en: We were lucky to catch the last train home.
lucky.zh: 我們很幸運趕上最後一班回家的火車。

lunch.en: We discussed the project during lunch in the cafeteria.
lunch.zh: 我們午餐時在餐廳討論了專題。

machine.en: The machine stops automatically if the temperature becomes too high.
machine.zh: 溫度過高時，機器會自動停止。

magazine.en: The library subscribes to several science magazines for students.
magazine.zh: 圖書館訂閱了幾本給學生閱讀的科學雜誌。

main.en: The main reason for the change was improved safety.
main.zh: 這項改變的主要原因是提升安全。

mainly.en: The course is mainly designed for first-year students.
mainly.zh: 這門課主要是為一年級學生設計的。

maintain.en: Regular practice helps maintain skills over a long period.
maintain.zh: 規律練習有助於長期維持能力。

major.en: Traffic is a major problem in many large cities.
major.zh: 交通是許多大城市的一項主要問題。

make.en: Careful planning can make a difficult project easier to manage.
make.zh: 仔細規劃能讓困難的專題更容易處理。

manage.en: She learned to manage her time more effectively before exams.
manage.zh: 她學會在考試前更有效管理時間。

manager.en: The manager explained the new schedule to the staff.
manager.zh: 經理向員工說明了新的排班。

many.en: Many students use flashcards to review vocabulary.
many.zh: 許多學生使用單字卡複習單字。

map.en: The map shows several walking routes around the park.
map.zh: 這張地圖顯示公園周邊的幾條步行路線。

mark.en: Please mark the correct answer clearly on the sheet.
mark.zh: 請在答案紙上清楚標示正確答案。

market.en: The night market becomes especially busy on weekends.

material.en: This material is strong enough to support the model.
material.zh: 這種材料夠堅固，可以支撐模型。

matter.en: Small details can matter when the final score is close.
matter.zh: 當分數很接近時，小細節也可能很重要。

may.en: The outdoor event may be canceled if the rain continues.
may.zh: 如果雨一直下，戶外活動可能會取消。

maybe.en: Maybe we should compare the two plans again before deciding.
maybe.zh: 也許我們應該在決定前再比較一次兩個方案。

meal.en: A balanced meal should include several different kinds of food.
meal.zh: 均衡的一餐應包含多種不同食物。

mean.en: What does this expression mean in the passage?
mean.zh: 這個表達方式在文章中是什麼意思？

meaning.en: Context often helps readers understand the meaning of an unfamiliar word.
meaning.zh: 語境常能幫助讀者理解陌生單字的意思。

measure.en: The students used a ruler to measure the width of the box.
measure.zh: 學生用尺測量箱子的寬度。

media.en: Social media can spread information very quickly.
media.zh: 社群媒體能非常快速地傳播資訊。

medical.en: The school invited a medical expert to speak about public health.
medical.zh: 學校邀請一位醫療專家談公共衛生。

medicine.en: Take the medicine exactly as the doctor instructed.
medicine.zh: 請完全按照醫師指示服用藥物。

meet.en: We will meet in front of the library after class.
meet.zh: 下課後我們會在圖書館前碰面。

meeting.en: The meeting ended early because everyone agreed on the plan.
meeting.zh: 因為大家都同意這個計畫，會議提早結束。

member.en: Every member of the team has a different responsibility.
member.zh: 團隊中的每位成員都有不同責任。

memory.en: Regular review can improve long-term memory of new vocabulary.
memory.zh: 規律複習能提升新單字的長期記憶。

message.en: I sent a short message to confirm the meeting time.
message.zh: 我傳了一則簡短訊息確認會議時間。

method.en: The teacher introduced a simple method for organizing notes.
method.zh: 老師介紹了一個整理筆記的簡單方法。

middle.en: The school is located in the middle of the neighborhood.
middle.zh: 學校位於這個社區的中央。

might.en: This change might improve the final result.
might.zh: 這項改變可能會改善最後結果。

mile.en: The trail continues for another mile beyond the bridge.
mile.zh: 這條步道過橋後還延伸一英里。

milk.en: She drank a glass of milk with breakfast.
milk.zh: 她早餐時喝了一杯牛奶。

mind.en: Keep an open mind when listening to different opinions.
mind.zh: 聽取不同意見時要保持開放的心態。

minute.en: Please wait one minute while I check the schedule.
minute.zh: 請等一分鐘，我確認一下行程。

miss.en: You may miss important details if you read too quickly.
miss.zh: 如果讀得太快，你可能會漏掉重要細節。

mistake.en: A small mistake can change the final answer completely.
mistake.zh: 一個小錯誤可能完全改變最後答案。

model.en: The students built a model to explain how the system works.
model.zh: 學生做了一個模型來說明系統如何運作。

modern.en: Modern technology has changed the way people communicate.
modern.zh: 現代科技改變了人們溝通的方式。

moment.en: Please wait a moment while the file finishes loading.
moment.zh: 請稍等一下，讓檔案載入完成。

money.en: She saved enough money to buy a new laptop.
money.zh: 她存了足夠的錢買一台新筆電。

month.en: The project must be completed by the end of this month.
month.zh: 這項專題必須在這個月底前完成。

more.en: We need more evidence before making a final decision.
more.zh: 做最後決定前，我們需要更多證據。

morning.en: I usually review vocabulary for ten minutes every morning.
morning.zh: 我通常每天早上複習十分鐘單字。

most.en: Most students finished the assignment before the deadline.
most.zh: 大多數學生都在期限前完成了作業。

mother.en: My mother helped me prepare lunch for the trip.
mother.zh: 我媽媽幫我準備旅程的午餐。

mountain.en: The mountain trail becomes slippery after heavy rain.
mountain.zh: 大雨後山徑會變得濕滑。

move.en: Please move your chair closer to the table.

movie.en: The class watched a short movie about ocean conservation.
movie.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋保育的短片。

much.en: This method requires much less time than the original one.
much.zh: 這個方法比原本的方法省下很多時間。

music.en: Soft music can help some students relax while studying.
music.zh: 輕柔音樂能幫助一些學生在讀書時放鬆。

must.en: Students must follow the safety rules in the laboratory.
must.zh: 學生在實驗室必須遵守安全規則。

my.en: I wrote my name at the top of the page.
my.zh: 我把名字寫在頁面上方。
